title: The Rockefeller Files
author: Gary Allen
description: The Rockefeller File by Gary Allen (1976, '76 Press), the American conservative writer and John Birch Society spokesman best known for None Dare Call It Conspiracy. Allen argues that the Rockefeller family, through its banks, oil interests, foundations and policy bodies such as the Council on Foreign Relations, the Trilateral Commission and the Federal Reserve system, has pursued a programme of economic and political control leading toward world government. Chapters examine the Rockefeller dynasty from John D. Rockefeller's Standard Oil onward, Nelson Rockefeller's political ambitions, foreign aid, trade with the Soviet Union, environmental and population policy, and the role of tax-exempt foundations. A key text of Cold War-era American conspiracy literature, it is catalogued under Other and should be read as political polemic rather than balanced history.
